chk_requests_resolver.name: chk_requests_resolver
chk_requests_resolver.value: "child_requests"."status" NOT IN ('approved', 'rejected') OR "child_requests"."resolved_by_parent_id" IS NOT NULL

chk_sessions_start.name: chk_sessions_start
chk_sessions_start.value:
("sessions"."status" = 'scheduled' AND "sessions"."scheduled_start_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sessions"."started_at" IS NULL)
			OR ("sessions"."status" IN ('running', 'paused', 'finished') AND "sessions"."started_at" IS NOT NULL)
			OR ("sessions"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "sessions"."started_at" IS NULL AND "sessions"."scheduled_start_at" IS NOT NULL)

chk_sessions_end.name: chk_sessions_end
chk_sessions_end.value:
("sessions"."status" = 'finished' AND "sessions"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sessions"."end_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "sessions"."consumed_seconds" IS NOT NULL)
			OR ("sessions"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "sessions"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sessions"."ended_by_parent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sessions"."end_reason" IS NULL AND "sessions"."consumed_seconds" IS NULL)
			OR ("sessions"."status" IN ('scheduled', 'running', 'paused') AND "sessions"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "sessions"."end_reason" IS NULL AND "sessions"."consumed_seconds" IS NULL)

chk_sessions_ender.name: chk_sessions_ender
chk_sessions_ender.value: "sessions"."end_reason" IS NULL OR "sessions"."end_reason" = 'auto_closed' OR "sessions"."ended_by_parent_id" IS NOT NULL
